death.note: Died in Rabīʿ al-Awwal 877 H after being severely beaten, repeatedly, time after time.

relation.note: He was the son of Baybars's brother (ابن أخي بيبرس), i.e. Baybars was his paternal uncle. Baybars = AIND-D02230 (Baybars b. Aḥmad b. Baqar, shaykh al-ʿUrbān of al-Sharqiyya; cf. Qāsim b. Baybars = D06212). Replaces contaminated TMP-P-000066.

state.label: شيخ عرب
shaykh ʿArab
state.note: Shaykh (chief) of the Arabs/bedouin of al-Sharqiyya. New TMP-O-00095 (replaces phantom TMP-O-00038).

person.note: バカル・ブン・ラーシド・ブン・アフマド。アッ＝シャルキーヤのアラブ（遊牧民）のシャイフ（首長）であり、バイバルス（D02230）の甥（兄弟の子）。877年ラビーウ・アル＝アウワル月に、繰り返し激しい暴行を受けた末に死亡した。

Baqar b. Rāshid b. Aḥmad, shaykh (chief) of the Arabs of al-Sharqiyya and the nephew (brother's son) of Baybars (AIND-D02230). He died in Rabīʿ al-Awwal 877 H after being severely beaten, time after time.
